# Cloud puff: a faceted ball of cloud r 1 m (scaled per instance), white with its underside in
# ice blue; the faces pointing straight down deleted (never seen). Origin at its centre.
new
material new Cloud --base-color 0.9804 1.0000 0.9882 --no-slot
material new Under --base-color 0.6392 0.7529 0.9020 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Puff --subdivisions 2 --radius 1.0 --location 0 0 0
material assign Cloud
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < -0.35"
material assign Under
select face where "normal.z < -0.8"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export puff.glb
